title: Preventing InfiniteHits custom component re renders
body:
Hey guys!

I have a parent functional component that holds a custom algolia child class component, `connectInfiniteHits(childComponent)` and that component renders out a list of Hit components. I'm having issues trying to keep the child component from re rendering every time the parent state change. I've tried using shouldComponentUpdate to compare different hit lengths, but I'm finding out that the render function gets called before the shouldComponentUpdate hook does so the render gets executed before shouldComponentUpdate could return false. What do you guys suggest I try?

Thanks!

comments.body:
Hey @lmuseau, could you recreate what you currently have in a sandbox? I'm not sure I understand what the problem is. Is there an issue with rendering when the hits are equal but the refinement not yet taken in account?

Note that comparing on the length alone is not a good idea, as two different queries likely have the same length, if there is more than one page.

Hey @lmuseau! Any updates on this?

You can use [this sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/React%20InstantSearch/getting-started) to create a reproducible. This will help us pinpoint what exactly is going wrong.
